sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm checking tomorrow's airport bus ticket.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I open the help chat at my hotel before breakfast.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, can I save it to my phone?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course, open your booking and choose Download ticket.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, I can download it while I'm on Wi-Fi.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Right, keep it in your saved tickets.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I open it offline at the bus stop?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, this ticket works offline once you've saved it.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Good, I won't need Wi-Fi outside.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, check it before you leave.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I follow the steps and find my saved ticket.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I've found it, and I can see the barcode.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Great, show that when you get on.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Should I turn off Wi-Fi to check it works offline?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, turn off Wi-Fi and data, then open it again.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Okay, it's still there, and I can show the barcode.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Perfect, you've got your ticket ready.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I turn Wi-Fi back on now?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, it's only off for that check.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll save it to my phone and keep it handy.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Great, make sure your phone has enough charge.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I ask about a backup screenshot.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: A screenshot's fine here if the whole barcode shows, not just the number.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, what needs to be visible in the screenshot?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: The whole barcode, not just the number.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Got it, I'll take a screenshot with the whole barcode.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's fine for this bus ticket, and keep it clear.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I show the barcode from my saved ticket instead?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, either one works here if it's readable.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll keep both ready so I can find them quickly.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: You're welcome, have a good trip to the airport.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've checked my saved ticket works offline before I leave.
